title: Reconcile negative control planted its defect on an encounter the ledger does not hold, so the plant changed 0 rows
what_went_wrong: p12_reconcile_negctl.sh picked the planted encounter from sik.detail_nota_jalan alone; the first row was a native (non-DR) encounter, 2026/02/25/000001, with no ledger rows.
The UPDATE on the scratch ledger therefore changed 0 rows, the second arm equalled the first, and the control printed P12-NC: NOT-DISCRIMINATING (exit 1). The chain recorded reconctl=1.
root_cause: The control did not assert that its mutation took effect (no ROW_COUNT check) and chose the target from one table without joining the table being mutated.
detection: The control's own verdict. It failed loudly rather than passing vacuously.
impact: No false claim: the failing run is kept (evidence/p12/r5_p12_reconcile_negctl_FAILED_plant_noop_20261024T114800Z.log) and the chain log still shows reconctl=1.

correction.applied: Target now joins detail_nota_jalan with the scratch ledger, and the script aborts (exit 3) unless ROW_COUNT() = 1. The tool was unfrozen, fixed, deployed and re-frozen (manifest 20261024c; only p12_reconcile_negctl.sh changed).
correction.result: Re-run under a held lock: planted on 2026/10/01/000254; S1 reports exactly that encounter and S2 B-vs-C reports it; P12-NC: DISCRIMINATING (evidence/p12/r5_p12_reconcile_negctl_20261024T1155Z.log).

rule: A negative control must assert that its mutation took effect before it is allowed to report a verdict.
